name: Gradient-Density Raycasting with Transfer Function Blending
definition: A fragment-based volume rendering technique that performs raycasting in the fragment shader, sampling density and gradient simultaneously, blending between two transfer functions based on an index, and applying silhouette and gradient magnitude modulation for shading.
summary: Gradient-Density Raycasting is a fragment-based volume rendering technique that explicitly computes gradient vectors per sample to drive shading and opacity modulation, distinguishing itself from standard raycasting by using fixed step counts and simultaneous density-gradient sampling.
